markets.question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's firm grip on China's Communist Party institutions drives the near-certain trader consensus that he will remain in power through 2026. With no scheduled leadership transition or term expiration before the 21st Party Congress in autumn 2027, and no designated successor in the Politburo Standing Committee, structural barriers remain high. Recent military leadership changes and ongoing purges have reinforced rather than eroded his authority, while elite alignment around his positions limits visible internal challenges. Realistic shifts could still arise from unforeseen health developments or rapid elite realignments ahead of the congress, though such events lack supporting indicators in current reporting.
